profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
I thrive on pushing boundaries and seeking constant improvement. Whether it's enhancing processes, refining aesthetics, or optimizing functionality, I'm always eager to innovate.

Exploring emerging technologies is my passion, and I approach it with unwavering determination. I enjoy staying abreast of the latest developments in the tech world, constantly seeking to expand my knowledge and skill set.

Creativity fuels my work, and I strive to infuse every project with originality and flair. Mediocrity has no place in my approach; I'm committed to elevating each endeavor to stand out in its own right.

Proficient in a diverse range of technologies including Shopify, Docker, Proxmox, JavaScript, Git, Linux, SQL, PICK BASIC, Python, Go, and React.

Feel free to explore my portfolio on GitHub: https://github.com/MikeSS281986.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
-Building of websites for clients
-Development of web applications for entertainment, business and various causes
-Continued education through a multitude of platforms
-Problem solving with a very curious nature, I tend to always gravitate towards finding solutions for common and complex issues. 
-Being very tenacious to learn new technologies 
-Primarily work in a Linux environment and for windows applications; Windows 10 with Visual Studio
-Knowledgeable in HTML5, CSS3, Javascript, Bootstrap,SASS,Java, Git, familiar with JQuery, SQL, Learning React, Learning Angular, familiar with VB and C#. 
-Future learning: Python, Node.js, never ending list :)

positions.title: PC LAN Technician
positions.description:
-Administering users via Microsoft SCCM for software pushes and updates.
-Building PCs and laptop via imaging using SmartDeploy
-Setting up Terminals for call centers
-Installing software through manual means not through Microsoft SCCM.
-General Maintenance to network switch room. 
-Building of batch files for to ease deployment of some software.
-Help Desk
-Footprints ticketing system
-Blackberry UEM for work email

positions.title: MIS Support Specialist
positions.description:
•	Worked with VMWare VSphere virtual environments for server management
•	Knowledge with Acronis backup software
•	Server administration and general pc maintenance
•	PC and laptop configuration setup for software and domain accounts
•	Hard drive recovery
•	File recovery using Appassure
•	Cisco call manager administration for setting up Cisco desk phones and voicemail
•	Office 2007 – 2013 knowledgeable including installing, configuring, and training employees
•	Outlook setup and PST creation experience
•	Windows 7/10 expert support and minor XP support
•	Support with mobile devices, including android and iPhone support
•	Mobile device account configuration for Exchange email access and installing Meraki remote management
•	Supplying smartphones/tablets for employees as well managing repairs, replacements and upgrades
•	Meraki MDM support for managing mobile devices and applications
•	Installing and implementing windows updates 
•	Good working knowledge of active directory, group policy management and distribution creation
•	All hardware, software, and printer support, including maintenance, upgrades, etc.
•	Printer maintenance 
•	Network troubleshooting, setting up switches, running Ethernet cabling
•	Dameware remote connection help for company employees as well Microsoft remote connection
•	Freshdesk help desk ticketing system experience with interaction via email, phone and face to face to resolve issues
•	Lansweeper asset management experience
•	AnyConnect VPN installation experience
•	Working with hardware venders for product support, purchases and repairs
•	Audio and visual setups for meetings utilizing GoToMeeting and Lifesize

positions.title: Technician
positions.description:
Diagnosing vehicle problems and symptoms to make necessary repairs.
Mid level stress environment with deadlines on repairs while still keeping customer content. 
Answer phone calls from customers (average 5 a day) to schedule appointments also to answer questions to the best of my ability and then escalating phone call to manager.
Provided excellent customer care and satisfaction during stressful and lesser times.
Data entry: Properly navigating our system database (VAST) and  Lotus Notes.

positions.title: Automotive Detailer
positions.description:
Cleaned and detailed previous collision damaged vehicles.
Handled customer complaints with minor to mid level issues and escalate as needed.

positions.title: Technician
positions.description:
Diagnosing vehicle problems and symptoms to make necessary repairs.
Answered phone calls and provided the best of my ability to understand customer questions and provide clear thorough explanations.
Properly navigating our system database to check on inventory and customer information
